note: NECO Chemistry top-up (round 2): grows the bank to 150 items so students get two full 60-question papers without repeats. New angles - sublimation, electron configuration, valency and radicals, molar mass and concentration calculations (machine-verified), brine electrolysis, electroplating, indicators, greenhouse gas, Haber iron catalyst, activation energy, alkenes, isomers, esterification, haematite, galvanising, brass, flame tests, titration apparatus, distillation - near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
